_about: Each model keeps one colour in every video (owner, 2026-10-27: 'keep game 2's colors and from now on', like the voices in voice_cast.json). Keys are the model's short name as the game records it; values are names in village/colors.py PALETTE. Game 2 (06ce0859) set the first seven (each keeps its Game 2 seat colour). A model new to the videos gets a colour no model has yet (random from the unused ones; never red, the wolves' colour); colors.use_game() adds one automatically if a game brings a model that is not here. Game 1 keeps its own seat colours, as published.
